title: Engram: Multi-Stage Memory for Agentic Tuning of Heterogeneous Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.28356v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can now tune neural networks, yet without cross-session memory they spend costly trials rediscovering known lessons. Reuse is difficult because production models differ in architecture, training setup and inference budget. We present Engram, a memory system that links past trial outcomes with the hypotheses and rationale behind them and assesses whether this evidence applies to the current model. An online agent curates evidence at the decision points where it is needed: Initial Guidance supplies validated lessons at the start, Session Retrieval supplies related past sessions before each batch of hypotheses is generated, and Trial Candidate Review checks each trial candidate against matching past trials. Between sessions, an offline agent distills validated lessons, making the memory self-improving. translated_title: Engram：用于异构模型智能体调优的多阶段记忆系统
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体现在可以调优神经网络，但若缺乏跨会话记忆，它们将花费昂贵的试验成本去重新发现已被知晓的经验。复用之所以困难，是因为生产模型在架构、训练设置和推理预算上各不相同。我们提出了 Engram，一种将过去试验结果与其背后的假设和理由相链接，并评估这些证据是否适用于当前模型的记忆系统。一个在线智能体在需要证据的决策点处整理证据：初始引导在开始时提供经过验证的经验，会话检索在每批假设生成前提供相关的过往会话，试验候选审查则将每个试验候选与匹配的过往试验进行核对。在会话之间，一个离线智能体提炼经过验证的经验，使记忆系统实现自我改进。在两个广告模型上，Engram 以减少 47% 的试验次数，达到了无记忆对照组 32 次试验所取得的调优效果。
tldr: Engram 是一个多阶段记忆系统，通过在线智能体在关键决策点整理证据、离线智能体提炼验证经验实现记忆的自我改进，使 LLM 智能体在调优异构模型时以减少 47% 的试验次数达到无记忆基线的效果。
en_tdlr: Engram is a multi-stage memory system that enables self-improving cross-session memory by curating evidence at decision points online and distilling validated lessons offline, allowing LLM agents to tune heterogeneous models with 47% fewer trials than a no-memory baseline.
